ID.name: ID
ID.description: The identifier of the patient who underwent the examination, linking to the Patient table.

Examination Date.name: Examination Date
Examination Date.description: The date on which the clinical examination was conducted.

aCL IgG.name: aCL IgG
aCL IgG.description: Anticardiolipin antibody of the IgG isotype, a key marker for antiphospholipid syndrome (APS) associated with thrombosis and pregnancy complications.

aCL IgM.name: aCL IgM
aCL IgM.description: Anticardiolipin antibody of the IgM isotype, another antiphospholipid marker used in the diagnosis of APS.

ANA.name: ANA
ANA.description: Antinuclear antibody titer, a broad screening test for autoimmune conditions, particularly systemic lupus erythematosus.

ANA Pattern.name: ANA Pattern
ANA Pattern.description: The immunofluorescence staining pattern of the ANA test, which helps distinguish the specific autoimmune condition (e.g., homogeneous, speckled, peripheral).

aCL IgA.name: aCL IgA
aCL IgA.description: Anticardiolipin antibody of the IgA isotype, a supplementary antiphospholipid marker occasionally evaluated alongside IgG and IgM.

Diagnosis.name: Diagnosis
Diagnosis.description: The medical diagnosis recorded at the time of the examination, which may differ from or refine the primary diagnosis in the Patient table.

KCT.name: KCT
KCT.description: Kaolin clotting time, a lupus anticoagulant screening test measuring prolonged clotting in the presence of antiphospholipid antibodies.

RVVT.name: RVVT
RVVT.description: Russell's Viper Venom Time, a confirmatory test for lupus anticoagulant used in antiphospholipid syndrome evaluation.

LAC.name: LAC
LAC.description: Lupus anticoagulant test result, indicating the presence of antiphospholipid antibodies that paradoxically prolong clotting tests in vitro.

Symptoms.name: Symptoms
Symptoms.description: Clinical symptoms reported or observed at the time of examination, recorded as free text describing the patient's presenting complaints.

Thrombosis.name: Thrombosis
Thrombosis.description: Indicates whether a thrombotic event was present at the time of examination, recorded as a numeric value (0 = no thrombosis, 1 = thrombosis present).

Examination.description: Records representing clinical examination findings for patients, including autoantibody test results, coagulation screening, diagnosis at the time of examination, and the presence or absence of thrombosis. This table focuses on immunological and antiphospholipid syndrome-related assessments.

ID.name: ID
ID.description: The identifier of the patient for whom the laboratory tests were conducted, linking to the Patient table.

Date.name: Date
Date.description: The date on which the laboratory tests were performed or the sample was collected.

GOT.name: GOT
GOT.description: Glutamate oxaloacetate transaminase (also known as AST), a liver enzyme used to assess liver and cardiac health.

GPT.name: GPT
GPT.description: Glutamate pyruvate transaminase (also known as ALT), a liver enzyme primarily used to evaluate liver function.

LDH.name: LDH
LDH.description: Lactate dehydrogenase, an enzyme present in many body tissues, elevated in cases of tissue damage or disease.

ALP.name: ALP
ALP.description: Alkaline phosphatase, an enzyme associated with liver, bone, and biliary tract conditions.

TP.name: TP
TP.description: Total protein level in the blood, reflecting overall nutritional status and liver function.

ALB.name: ALB
ALB.description: Albumin, the most abundant protein in blood, used to assess liver function and nutritional status.

UA.name: UA
UA.description: Uric acid level in the blood, elevated in conditions such as gout or renal dysfunction.

UN.name: UN
UN.description: Urea nitrogen (blood urea nitrogen), a marker of kidney function and protein metabolism.

CRE.name: CRE
CRE.description: Creatinine level in the blood, a key indicator of kidney (renal) function.

T-BIL.name: T-BIL
T-BIL.description: Total bilirubin level, used to evaluate liver function and detect conditions such as jaundice or hemolysis.

T-CHO.name: T-CHO
T-CHO.description: Total cholesterol level in the blood, used to assess cardiovascular risk.

TG.name: TG
TG.description: Triglyceride level, a type of fat in the blood used to evaluate cardiovascular and metabolic health.

CPK.name: CPK
CPK.description: Creatine phosphokinase, a muscle enzyme elevated in conditions such as muscle injury, myocardial infarction, or myositis.

GLU.name: GLU
GLU.description: Blood glucose level, used to screen for and monitor diabetes and other metabolic conditions.

WBC.name: WBC
WBC.description: White blood cell count, reflecting immune system activity and used to detect infection or hematological conditions.

RBC.name: RBC
RBC.description: Red blood cell count, used to assess oxygen-carrying capacity and detect anemia or polycythemia.

HGB.name: HGB
HGB.description: Hemoglobin level, the oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells, used to diagnose and monitor anemia.

HCT.name: HCT
HCT.description: Hematocrit, the proportion of red blood cells in total blood volume, used in anemia and hydration assessment.

PLT.name: PLT
PLT.description: Platelet count, used to evaluate clotting ability and detect conditions such as thrombocytopenia or thrombocytosis.

PT.name: PT
PT.description: Prothrombin time, a coagulation test measuring how long blood takes to clot via the extrinsic pathway.

APTT.name: APTT
APTT.description: Activated partial thromboplastin time, a coagulation test evaluating the intrinsic clotting pathway.

FG.name: FG
FG.description: Fibrinogen level, a clotting protein that plays a central role in blood coagulation and is elevated in inflammatory states.

PIC.name: PIC
PIC.description: Plasmin-alpha2-plasmin inhibitor complex, a marker of fibrinolytic activity and clot breakdown.

TAT.name: TAT
TAT.description: Thrombin-antithrombin complex, a marker of thrombin generation and coagulation activation.

TAT2.name: TAT2
TAT2.description: Secondary thrombin-antithrombin complex measurement, providing an additional quantitative assessment of coagulation activation.

U-PRO.name: U-PRO
U-PRO.description: Urine protein level, used to detect proteinuria, which may indicate kidney disease or systemic conditions affecting renal filtration.

IGG.name: IGG
IGG.description: Immunoglobulin G level, the most abundant antibody in serum, reflecting humoral immunity and used in autoimmune disease evaluation.

IGA.name: IGA
IGA.description: Immunoglobulin A level, an antibody associated with mucosal immunity and elevated or decreased in various immune conditions.

IGM.name: IGM
IGM.description: Immunoglobulin M level, the first antibody produced in response to infection, used to detect acute immune responses.

CRP.name: CRP
CRP.description: C-reactive protein, an acute-phase inflammatory marker elevated in infections, autoimmune diseases, and tissue injury.

RA.name: RA
RA.description: Rheumatoid arthritis factor test result, used as a serological marker in the diagnosis of rheumatoid arthritis.

RF.name: RF
RF.description: Rheumatoid factor level, an autoantibody associated with rheumatoid arthritis and other autoimmune conditions.

C3.name: C3
C3.description: Complement C3 protein level, part of the innate immune system, decreased in active lupus or immune complex disease.

C4.name: C4
C4.description: Complement C4 protein level, another component of the complement system, used alongside C3 in autoimmune disease monitoring.

RNP.name: RNP
RNP.description: Anti-ribonucleoprotein antibody, associated with mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD) and systemic lupus erythematosus.

SM.name: SM
SM.description: Anti-Smith antibody, a highly specific autoantibody for systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE).

SC170.name: SC170
SC170.description: Anti-Scl-70 (anti-topoisomerase I) antibody, a marker associated with systemic sclerosis (scleroderma).

SSA.name: SSA
SSA.description: Anti-SSA/Ro antibody, associated with Sjögren's syndrome, neonatal lupus, and systemic lupus erythematosus.

SSB.name: SSB
SSB.description: Anti-SSB/La antibody, associated with Sjögren's syndrome and systemic lupus erythematosus.

CENTROMEA.name: CENTROMEA
CENTROMEA.description: Anti-centromere antibody, a marker associated with the CREST variant of systemic sclerosis.

DNA.name: DNA
DNA.description: Anti-double stranded DNA antibody, a highly specific marker for systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), used for diagnosis and monitoring.

DNA-II.name: DNA-II
DNA-II.description: Quantitative anti-double stranded DNA antibody level, providing a numeric measurement of anti-dsDNA antibody concentration.
